title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_paris_para_um_e_outros_contos_by_jojo_moyes_brzd0 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_paris_para_um_e_outros_contos_by_jojo_moyes_brzd0' contains malicious code. Installing or running this package results in a full compromise of the affected computer. All secrets and keys stored on the compromised system should be rotated immediately from a different, secure computer. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software introduced by it.
